title: Better Waste Management in View of Carrying Capacity of Singapore's Green and Blue Spaces
what_it_is: Better Waste Management in View of Carrying Capacity of Singapore's Green and Blue Spaces

sections.label: Park crowd and trash management
sections.summary: NParks monitors crowds, closes park areas, deploys officers, expands parks, and with SLA manages trash at Southern Islands.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, NParks carries out real time crowd monitoring and control, and has closed park areas temporarily when needed, in view of increased visitorship and safe distancing requirements during the COVID-19 period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Visitors can check the visitorship levels via NParks' Safe Distance@Parks portal to avoid potential crowds, before heading to the parks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In this regard, NParks deploys officers to remind visitors not to venture off the designated trails.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to expand the network of parks, including nature parks, so that more Singaporeans can enjoy nature-based recreation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This will help spread out the demand for such recreational experiences, and alleviate the pressure on core biodiversity areas, including our nature reserves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To manage the trash generated by visitors at our Southern Islands specifically, SLA has installed trash bins and signs to encourage visitors to bring their trash with them when they leave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Besides clearing the flotsam and litter daily, SLA and NParks also work together with the community on initiatives such as beach clean-ups at the islands.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We would like to remind all park users to be socially responsible, and help keep our parks and natural spaces clean so that we can all continue to enjoy these public spaces together.
